added_claims.conditions: high dispersion, low index/basket trading share

corrections.issue: Date and attribution are over-specific: the speaker says he arrived in September 2011 and did the trade 'I think 5 days in' (garbled caption), and only says 'John Corzine's firm got liquidated out of their Italian Bond position'; the claim states the liquidation happened in Sept 2011 and names MF Global.
corrections.fix: Soon after arriving at Soros in autumn 2011, John Corzine's firm (MF Global) was liquidated out of its Italian bond position and Soros took the whole $3.5bn trade with repo from JP Morgan, showing that large liquid capital earns by absorbing forced sellers.
